name: Hard rule-chain
description: Write JAX get_observation(state) and compute_reward(state, action, next_state) for a 13 x 13 four-room XLand-MiniGrid task (blue pyramid becomes a green ball; place it next to the yellow hex); LIMEN's evaluator trains PPO on them and scores the mean success rate within 400 steps over three 5M-step seeds, or a 3M-step cascade run's rate if below 1 % (higher is better).

sources.locator: limen/evaluator.py (CascadeEvaluator), limen/train.py (PPO), limen/adapters/xminigrid.py, configs/hard_rule_chain.yaml, rulesets/hard_rule_chain.py and examples/evolved_interfaces/hard_rule_chain.py (MIT); run unchanged by the evaluator
XLand-MiniGrid 0.9.3 (Apache-2.0): environments, goal checks and rules; byte-identical to the PyPI wheel xminigrid==0.9.3
